# awscc_redshift_snapshot_copy_grant (Resource)

Creates a snapshot copy grant that permits Amazon Redshift to use an encrypted symmetric key from AWS Key Management Service (KMS) to encrypt copied snapshots in a destination region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot_copy_grant_name` (String) The name of the snapshot copy grant. This name must be unique in the region for the AWS account.

### Optional

- `kms_key_id` (String) The unique identifier of the encrypted symmetric key to which to grant Amazon Redshift permission. If no key is specified, the default key is used. Marked writeOnly because Create accepts aliases/key-ids but Describe returns the resolved key ARN, which would fail drift detection.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tag instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot copy grant.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key, or name, for the resource tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the resource tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_redshift_snapshot_copy_grant.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot copy grant

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_redshift_snapshot_copy_grant.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
